title: rate_limiter HashMap grows unboundedly between O(n) eviction scans under DDoS
description: rate_limiter.rs: eviction only runs every EVICT_INTERVAL=1024 calls. Under a DDoS from N distinct IPs, the HashMap grows to N entries before the next eviction pass. With N=100k IPs each entry ~88 bytes = ~8 MB held until the next 1024-call cycle completes. Consider a maximum map size cap or use an LRU structure (e.g. lru crate) bounded by entry count rather than a periodic full scan.
